findings.defect: Thin toe skirts and unsupported ankle pad
findings.evidence: Front/iso recess edges at sole; thickness reports three walls7.9..16.5mm2; support report2.8mm2 at print(13.1,6.6,15)
findings.repair: Open the claw recesses forward as full-width toe slots and add a45-degree buttress beneath the ankle pad.

observation: The bent paw silhouette and upper mounting pad are coherent. Front/iso show claw recesses cutting scalloped thin skirts through the toe edge; the mounting pad also projects beyond its lower support.
